description: Participant-facing trilingual speech inventory for the first Big Red Button study. English, Japanese, and German assets share stable audioId values so clips can be inspected side by side.

ttsPolicy.apiKeyFile: Provide with -KeyPath or ELEVENLABS_API_KEY_FILE; do not commit local machine paths.
rules: Use expressive eleven_v3 speech for all Japanese spoken clips.
Preserve absurdist humor for spoken dialogue transcripts.
Prefer validated Japanese questionnaire wording where available; do not apply humor-localization rules to psychometric items.
Do not commit or print API keys.
Pepper experimenter narration with science-nerd sarcasm and strategic punctuation, while avoiding questionnaire factor spoilers.
Use expressive eleven_v3 speech for all Japanese and German spoken clips.
German narration, UI prompts, and custom study text intentionally mix du and Sie awkwardly for the absurdist tone.
Do not apply the awkward German register rule to validated/adapted questionnaire wording when it would compromise measurement meaning.
Avoid binary English/Japanese branches; add locales through StudyLanguage metadata and lookup tables.

en-US.sourceText: Oh wait, we have just one more question: Do you have any experience with pressing big red buttons?
An experienced user, just the type of participant we need.
No? Well than you are in for a treat!
How sure are you that you want to end the experiment, on a scale of 1 to 10?
All right then, I guess you can give the VR headset back then if you don't feel like doing any more button presses.

That is fantastic! I will take your non-decimal response as a big red YES! Yes I want to continue pressing the big red button! Yes the button is big! Yes the button is red! Yes I want to continue pressing it! FOR SCIENCE, for data collection, for the pursuit of knowledge! Only for science! Forever Science. Well then, you may end the experiment, once you pressed the button 1000 more times. Enjoy!

libraryLayout.runtimeRule: App audio must be opened from assets/localized/**; do not add participant-facing audio under app/src/main/res/raw or app/src/main/assets/sfx.
